<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_IssueReported" name="Issue reported on delivery"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentCheck" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Order ended: payment failed"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck" name="Items out of stock?" default="Flow_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_InitiateBackOrder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer of delay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BackOrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_BackOrderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockAvailable" name="Required items available"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" name="Start fulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick in-stock items from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_QualityCheck" name="Perform quality control check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapDecision" name="Gift wrap requested?" default="Flow_NoGiftWrap"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" name="Gift wrap decision done"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Package" name="Package order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalCheck" name="International order?" default="Flow_Domestic"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomsDocs" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingDocsMerge" name="Shipping documentation done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadyJoin" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Dispatch" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation to customer"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_DeliveryOutcome" name="Delivery outcome"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Successful delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_IssueReported" name="Customer reports issue">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_IssueReported" messageRef="Msg_IssueReported"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send follow-up feedback email"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackSent" name="Feedback request sent"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Returns process">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_Returns" name="Return initiated"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label"/>
      <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveReturn" name="Receive returned items"/>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectReturn" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RefundOrReplace" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Returns" name="Return handled"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_1" sourceRef="SubStart_Returns" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturn" targetRef="Task_InspectReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturn" targetRef="Task_RefundOrReplace"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SubFlow_5" sourceRef="Task_RefundOrReplace" targetRef="SubEnd_Returns"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReturnHandled" name="Return processed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${paymentFailed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSuccess" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${outOfStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Event_BackOrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_BackOrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StockAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_StockAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_FulfillmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_QualityCheck" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapDecision" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${giftWrapRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" name="No gift wrap" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapDecision" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrapMerge" targetRef="Task_Package"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Package" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_International" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalCheck" targetRef="Task_CustomsDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${internationalOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Domestic" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_CustomsDocs" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingDocsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingDocsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyJoin" targetRef="Task_Dispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_Dispatch" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_DeliveryOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryOutcome" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_DeliveryOutcome" targetRef="Event_IssueReported"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Event_IssueReported" targetRef="SubProcess_Returns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="SubProcess_Returns" targetRef="EndEvent_ReturnHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
